<script src="starfield.js"></script>

<script>
(function(){
  // ---- Typewriter subtitle ----
  var typedEl = document.getElementById('sm-typed-text');
  if (typedEl) {
    var phrases = [
      'Interactive lectures, tools, and games for learning statistics and data science.',
      'From probability basics to regression, all free and open.',
      'Build charts, run simulations, and master core concepts.',
      'Plus a blog on stats theory, R & Python, and dev tips.'
    ];
    var pi = 0, ci = 0, deleting = false;

    function tick(){
      var current = phrases[pi];
      if (!deleting) {
        ci++;
        typedEl.textContent = current.slice(0, ci);
        if (ci === current.length) {
          deleting = true;
          setTimeout(tick, 1800);
          return;
        }
      } else {
        ci--;
        typedEl.textContent = current.slice(0, ci);
        if (ci === 0) {
          deleting = false;
          pi = (pi + 1) % phrases.length;
        }
      }
      setTimeout(tick, deleting ? 25 : 35);
    }
    tick();
  }

  // ---- Stat counters (animate when visible) ----
  var nums = document.querySelectorAll('.sm-num-value[data-count]');
  function animateCount(el){
    var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'), 10) || 0;
    var start = 0;
    var duration = 1200;
    var startTime = null;
    function frame(ts){
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      el.textContent = Math.floor(progress * (target - start) + start);
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else el.textContent = target;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCount(entry.target);
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    nums.forEach(function(n){ io.observe(n); });
  } else {
    nums.forEach(animateCount);
  }
})();
</script>
